page: Amazon Web Services g7.4xlarge is a graphics-intensive cloud server based on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel CPU running at 3.9 GHz, providing 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs without multithreading, alongside 64.0 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPU with 32 GB of VRAM. It includes 875 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and an 80 Gbps baseline network interface.

The configuration targets graphics rendering, 3D visualization, AI inference, and media processing. Cost efficiency is defined by the high resource density of combining dedicated CPU cores, direct GPU acceleration, local NVMe storage, and high network throughput in a single-socket footprint. A potential tradeoff is the single GPU and 64 GB memory capacity, which limits large-scale parallel model training.
description: Amazon Web Services g7.4xlarge is a graphics-accelerated instance powered by an x86_64 Intel CPU operating at 3.9 GHz with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the server provides 64.0 GB of system memory paired with a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPU with 32 GB of VRAM. Storage and network connectivity feature a bundled 875 GB NVMe SSD and 80 Gbps baseline bandwidth. This high-density architecture delivers cost-effective resource allocation for workstation tasks without multi-GPU overhead. The instance fits graphics rendering, 3D modeling, video encoding, and machine learning inference workloads.
